1.consolidated_definition: Echar a perder, dañar, romper o descomponer algo, por lo general de manera abrupta o violenta. María descabronó sistemas biológicos y sociales en Puerto Rico ya atacados de muerte previo al huracán. Asesinó a decenas de humanos, que en horas se multiplicaron a cientos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To ruin, damage, break or decompose something, often in a sudden or violent manner. María ravaged biological and social systems in Puerto Rico that were already on the brink of death before the hurricane struck. She killed dozens of people, who multiplied to hundreds within hours.
